title: Web Accessible Population Pharmacokinetics Service - Hemophilia: Sources of Variability
brief_summary: Using anonymized patient data collected as part of the WAPPS-Hemo project to explore the sources of variability in individual pharmacokinetics (PK); use the sources of variability to improve the performance of the WAPPS-Hemo models through the addition of the predictors of PK variability as covariates.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* individuals with hemophilia A or B
* infusion/PK data is available on the WAPPS-Hemo database
* given informed consent to data input on the WAPPS-Hemo database

Exclusion Criteria:

\- individuals currently undergoing immune tolerance induction
study_population: Participates are individuals with hemophilia A or B, any severity, who have agreed to input of their data in the WAPPS-Hemo database, and who have sufficient infusion/PK data.
